messages.content: Thank you for participating in this interview. To start, could you please share your high-level goals for enhancing the university student portal? What do you envision as the primary benefits of these enhancements for the students?

Sure! Honestly, I just want it to be easier to use. Like, the timetable is a bit of a mess right now. It would be great if I could see my classes more clearly and maybe colour-code them or something. Also, I really want to know when my grades are out without having to check all the time. And it would be nice to have a way to give feedback on my classes because, you know, some stuff could really be improved. That would really help us all out!

Thank you for sharing those thoughts. To clarify, it sounds like you’re looking for a more user-friendly experience with the timetable, specifically mentioning the ability to colour-code classes for better clarity. 

Could you elaborate on what specific features or functionalities you imagine for the personalised timetable management? For instance, what options might you want to have in terms of customisation?

Yeah, so I'd love it if I could, like, choose colours for each of my modules. That way, I can just glance and know what's what. And maybe if I could hide classes that are cancelled, that would be super helpful. Oh, and it would be cool if I could add in my own study blocks, like just a space for when I plan to study or do assignments. It would just make it a lot easier to see everything at a glance!

That’s very helpful, thank you. To summarise, for the personalised timetable management, you would like features that allow you to:

1. Choose colours for each of your modules.
2. Hide cancelled classes.
3. Add your own study blocks for better planning.

Now, regarding the automated grade notifications, could you specify how you would like to receive these notifications? For example, would you prefer push notifications, emails, or updates within the portal itself? What would work best for you?

I think getting an email would be best for me. I check my email all the time, so that way I wouldn't miss it. But if there was also a way to get a little pop-up in the portal, that could work too. Just something that lets me know right away when grades are posted, so I'm not left wondering for ages!

Thank you for that clarification. To summarise, you would prefer to receive grade notifications primarily via email, as you check your email frequently. You would also appreciate having a pop-up notification within the portal for immediate updates on when grades are posted.

Moving on to the module feedback system, could you describe how you envision providing feedback on your classes? For example, what specific features would you like to see in this feedback system? Would you prefer a simple rating system, open text fields for comments, or something else?

I think a simple rating system would be good, like just stars or something, so it’s quick. And then maybe a couple of open text fields for comments so I can add details if I want. It would help to share what’s working and what’s not for each module. Just something easy to fill out after the semester ends would be great!

That’s a valuable insight. To summarise, for the module feedback system, you would like:

1. A simple rating system, such as stars, for quick feedback.
2. Open text fields for additional comments to elaborate on your rating.
3. A mechanism to complete this feedback easily after the semester ends.

So far, we have the following requirements:

1. Personalised timetable management that allows users to choose colours for modules, hide cancelled classes, and add study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications sent primarily via email, with optional pop-up notifications in the portal.
3. A structured module feedback system featuring a star rating system and open text fields for comments.

Before we conclude, are there any limitations or restrictions we need to consider regarding these enhancements? For example, are there timeframes, budget constraints, or technical limitations that we should be aware of?

I honestly haven't really thought about any limitations or anything like that. I just know what would make things easier for us. I guess it would be good if everything worked smoothly without us having to do extra stuff, like creating new accounts or anything. But beyond that, I'm not sure what else might be an issue.

Thank you for your input. To summarise, while you haven't identified specific limitations, you do feel it's important that the enhancements work smoothly without requiring students to create new accounts or undertake any extra steps.

Based on our discussion, here are the gathered requirements:

1. Personalised timetable management that allows users to choose colours for modules, hide cancelled classes, and add study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications sent primarily via email, with optional pop-up notifications in the portal.
3. A structured module feedback system featuring a star rating system and open text fields for comments.
4. The enhancements should work smoothly without the need for students to create new accounts or perform extra steps.

With that, we have gathered sufficient information for the requirements. Thank you for your time and insights today.
